description: f32 [6, 4]: Large values (1000, 1001), -inf entries, a row of -inf, NaN, +inf, large negative values.
reference: torch.log_softmax(x, dim) in f64, rounded once to f32
notes: As in PyTorch: a row with NaN or +inf is NaN everywhere, a row of only -inf is NaN everywhere, and -inf next to finite values gives 0 (log_softmax: -inf). Expected NaN must be NaN (any NaN matches any NaN) and expected ±inf must be the same inf. out is computed in f64 from the inputs and rounded once to the dtype under test, so the bytes don't depend on the CPU's vectorized kernels; torch in the dtype itself meets the tolerance (checked by the generator).
